# Entropy-truncation reconstruction audit

## Verdict and scope

The proposed argument is valid, including for non-Hilbert–Schmidt-selfadjoint bistochastic channels. No reversibility, normality, or commutation between the channel and spectral truncation is required.

Let tau = Tr/d and let Phi be bistochastic. Assume a canonical bistochastic entanglement-breaking channel Psi satisfies the Hilbert–Schmidt superoperator comparison

0 <= I-Psi <= C [I-(Phi+Phi*)/2].

Canonicality also gives 0 <= Psi <= I in HS superoperator order. For binary self-compatibility the audited comparator supplies C = 8 in general, and C = 4 when Phi is HS-selfadjoint.

For a density operator rho put X = d rho, epsilon_rho = ||rho-Phi(rho)||_1, and g_K(X) = min(X,K I). For every K > e,

||rho-Psi(rho)||_1
 <= 2 D(rho || I/d)/(log K-1) + sqrt(C K epsilon_rho).

For an ensemble with mean I/d, Holevo information chi <= H, and average residual epsilon, the same Psi therefore satisfies

sum_x p_x ||rho_x-Psi(rho_x)||_1
 <= 2H/(log K-1) + sqrt(C K epsilon).

All logarithms in this note are natural. Norms with a tau subscript are normalized Schatten norms. The ordinary trace norm is used for density matrices.

## 1. Scalar truncation inequality: exact orientation

For t >= 0 define g(t) = min(t,K) and

F(t) = t^2/2 for t <= K;
F(t) = Kt-K^2/2 for t >= K.

Then F' = g and, for every a,b >= 0,

g(a)(a-b) >= F(a)-F(b) + (g(a)-g(b))^2/2.

This can be checked exactly, without appealing to a smooth-convex theorem. The difference between the left and right sides is zero if a,b <= K, if a,b >= K, or if b <= K <= a. If a <= K <= b, the difference is (K-a)(b-K) >= 0. Thus the stated orientation is correct.

## 2. Spectral transition weights and the nonselfadjoint channel

Write X = sum_i x_i P_i using its distinct eigenvalues and spectral projections. Set

w_i = tau(P_i),
p_ij = tau(P_i Phi(P_j)).

Positivity of Phi makes p_ij >= 0. Unitality and trace preservation respectively give

sum_j p_ij = w_i,
sum_i p_ij = w_j.

These are common-marginal joint weights; unless all projectors have the appropriate equal rank, the p_ij themselves should not be described as an ordinary row-normalized doubly stochastic matrix. Symmetry p_ij = p_ji is neither assumed nor needed.

Multiplying the scalar inequality by p_ij and summing cancels the F terms. The left side becomes

tau[g(X)(X-Phi(X))].

The squared-differ

ASTRA RESEARCH ADDENDUM
Bounded-capacity reconstruction, stochastic phases, and an operational boundary
9 October 2026 UTC

This is a separate immutable addendum to the third research record. It captures
subsequent mathematical progress without replacing or rebundling earlier ZIPs.

1. BOUNDED HOLEVO CAPACITY AND ONE COMMON CLASSICAL RECONSTRUCTION

Main proof:
entropy_comparator_continuation/BOUNDED_CAPACITY_BROADCASTING_THEOREM.md
Independent end-to-end audit:
entropy_comparator_continuation/END_TO_END_ADVERSARIAL_AUDIT.md

For every fixed finite capacity bound C, there is a dimension- and family-size-
independent modulus f_C(b) tending to zero as b tends to zero. If an experiment
has Holevo CAPACITY at most C and admits approximate broadcasting to two outputs
with worst-case half-trace error b, a SINGLE entanglement-breaking channel
reconstructs every state in that experiment with worst-case error at most f_C(b).
Capacity means a supremum over ALL finite priors. A bound for one chosen prior
is insufficient. The theorem permits growing dimensions and arbitrary family
cardinalities, while each experiment is finite dimensional. It produces a
full-domain finite-outcome physical channel; no uniform outcome count or
computational efficiency is promised.

The proof stitches compatible smoothing, binary extraction, finite flagged
centralization, Petz reference correction, and the weighted-tracial common C4
comparator. Supporting independent interface audits and the exact pinned source
proof extracts are included. The original common-comparator proof and audit
are included as dependencies, not as a new milestone in this addendum.

The end-to-end adversarial audit found no remaining composition gap. This is
positive internal analytic AI review, not formal verification, human peer
review, or established historical priority/significance. Early conditional
language in the chain and interface reports records checking order; the main
stitched theorem, final chain update and end-to-end audit state the final
status. PRIOR_LITERATURE_AND_SIGNIFICANCE.md compares the closest inspected
primary results; no matching capacity-uniform theorem was located, while
priority remains unestablished. A separate quantitative sharpening is still
in progress and is not asserted or included in this snapshot. No diamond-norm or unrestricted-input classicalization is claimed.

2. ROBUST UNDEC
